content.short: Banxa is a leading global fiat on-ramp and off-ramp service enabling users to convert fiat currency to crypto and vice versa on Mantle.
content.description: Banxa is one of the world's largest regulated fiat-to-crypto on-ramp and off-ramp service providers, processing billions in volume annually for crypto exchanges, wallets, and DeFi platforms across 100+ countries. The platform supports multiple payment methods including bank transfers, credit cards, and local payment options, with Banxa's integration with Mantle providing users a compliant, regulated pathway to convert fiat currency directly into Mantle-based assets.
content.meta: Banxa is a global fiat on-ramp solution enabling seamless crypto purchases and sales on Mantle. Discover Banxa on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
